# Where In The World Is Diane – David Rivera

> Where In The World Is Diane (2012) is a piano-led album by David Rivera, American composer. Free printable piano scores with chords are on Lackadaisical Perfection.

## Album
- [Where In The World Is Diane](https://whereintheworldisdiane.com/): the album page, with tracks and listen links.

10. New Delhi
11. Miami Beach
12. Maldives
13. Not Here
14. Shanghai
